label: Fault crossing: how far the road is offset (0 without surface rupture)

event_id.description: The scenario's USGS event id, whose magnitude (and rupture model) the function reads: the same map hazard.shakemap reads. The page sets it for every binding when an earthquake is chosen.

on_rupture_km.description: A crossing within this distance of the rupture model's top edge is on the rupture.

p_surface_rupture.description: P(surface rupture | M) = 1 / (1 + exp(-(a + b M))), Wells & Coppersmith (1993).

average_displacement.description: Wells & Coppersmith (1994) log10 AD = a + b M with sigma_log10, by slip type (strike-slip, all): the segment average where segment_offsets gives none.

on_trace_fraction.description: The share of the segment's average offset taken up at the mapped trace, where the road crosses; the rest is spread off it. 1 when left out.

segment_offsets.description: Measured average offsets of a scenario's rupture segments: {event_id: {source, sigma_ln, faults: {catalogue fault_id: {segment, average_m}}}}. A crossing whose fault is listed for the scenario takes its segment's average, with sigma_ln, in place of Wells & Coppersmith.

source.citation: Rupture geometry: the scenario ShakeMap's rupture.json. Wells & Coppersmith (1993) probability of surface rupture given M, as used by Youngs et al. (2003) and Petersen et al. (2011); coefficients not checked against the paper. Given it occurs: Wells & Coppersmith (1994) BSSA 84:974, Table 2B, average displacement on M. Measured segment averages, where an assembly gives them, are cited by the assembly.

description: A root. The crossing is on the scenario's rupture if it lies within on_rupture_km of the top edge of the ShakeMap's rupture model; there the fault ruptures to the surface with P = 1 / (1 + exp(-(a + b M))), elsewhere with P = 0. Given surface rupture, PGD is lognormal about the offset at the trace: on_trace_fraction times the segment's average offset. The average is the scenario's measured one for the crossed fault's segment where segment_offsets gives it (by the row's fault_id), with its sigma_ln; else the Wells & Coppersmith (1994) average displacement for M (strike-slip where the fault's slip type is sinistral or dextral, else all slip types), with theirs. Else PGD = 0. Occurrence is the event PGD > 0.
